event_name: Date 28 September 2019 Time 16:34 2019 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 September 2019 The Stewards have received a request from Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda to allow car 26 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 26, Daniil Kvyat, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Competitors are reminded that they have the right to appeal certain decisions of the Stewards, in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code and Article 9.1.1 of the FIA Judicial and Disciplinary Rules, within the applicable time limits.
rules_referenced: Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Decision Car 26 Failure To Set A Time In Qualifying
